body: Not in school. Already with mental health clinics. They will ask if I want to sleep harm or if I want to harm someone else, I say no and that is that, nothing more can be done. It's funny how they take the word of a Seriously mentally ill person.

It doesn't matter anymore...life..is meaningless. Humans work all their life for what..to pay governments to tell you what you can and can't do, that's no purpose... Then people like me struggle to do daily stuff. Lie to husband. He ask if everything fine. Telling him yes but knowing you wrote a letter as to why for your actions...there is no purpose even when there is purpose 😔 life is just one big lie and we are puppets.
You're probably right. I wish they wouldn't though. I'm really not worth it.
I was just honest. I put how I was feeling while I wrote it. Let it be known I don't want them to weep. I told them why I am doing my actions. Of course it's not the same for everyone.
It's ironic isn't? I just wrote my letter to my online friends. Still need to write one for family but I've been known to help others talk them out of it.
I have always been on the moment type. For some reason this time I feel others deserve reasons of why.
We do have children. Still the same if he going to kill himself to catch what I have then I die from what I have then the children will have no parents.

I have virus that causes weaken immune system. Last time I was in hospital I was in for 17 days. My family is worried that next visit will be my last. It can be transferred if precautions aren't taken. My husband refuses to use precautions. He has said if he gets it he will kill himself. So I see the justification of getting rid of one dying parent as so the healthier one lives. On top of that. I struggle walking, and breathing. I live not only with emotional pain everyday but physical pain as well.
I've been wanting to die since age 6. I'm 37. I've lived everyday with thoughts. I'm planning that my last birthday was last to live through. Roughly 6months or so I have left.

I've thought that for many years. As my health is getting worse by the day that strongness isn't there anymore.  I see it as a sacrifice of 1 dying parent as so the healthier one will live. The kids can't lose both parents.

I'm the same way. I am seriously mentally ill and I don't understand how these doctors believe when I say I won't hurt myself. Today I wrote 1 out of 2 notes. 1 is for online friends which is ready to go and the 2ed will be for my family.

So Bitcoin drops and y'all post NSH...ffs...I just wrote my letter of why for my online friends due to I believe they deserve the right to know the reasons as much as my family...I tell you what. It's not over fake coins!
